courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送
related.transfer: 可遷移「水化熱與厚度造成的近絕熱狀態」與「溫度監測佈點與資料判讀」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高強度混凝土高程泵送的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Hydration heat and near-adiabatic conditions from thickness" and "Temperature monitoring layout and data interpretation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以配比、澆置溫度、保溫與監測控制數萬立方公尺筏基的最高溫度與內外溫差；高強度混凝土高程泵送則以把黏稠的高強度混凝土推上數百公尺：靜壓、管壁摩擦、輸送管強度、可泵性與連續供料為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on controlling peak temperature and core-to-surface differential in rafts of tens of thousands of cubic metres through mix, placing temperature, insulation and monitoring; High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete centres on pushing viscous high-strength concrete hundreds of metres up: static head, wall friction, pipeline strength, pumpability and continuous supply, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「筏基核心溫升」與「泵送壓力需求」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高強度混凝土高程泵送，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Raft core temperature rise” and “Pump pressure demand”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 巨厚筏基水化熱控制
history.titleEn: Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations
history.text: 1930 年代美國胡佛水壩以分塊澆置與預埋冷卻水管控制巨積混凝土的水化熱，奠定大體積溫控的工程方法。超高層筏基把這些原則帶入建築：1999 年拉斯維加斯 Venetian 以約 21,000 立方碼創下連續澆置紀錄，2014 年 2 月洛杉磯 Wilshire Grand Center 以約 21,200 立方碼（約 16,200 m³）、約 20 小時的連續澆置刷新紀錄；三一重工公布上海中心大廈筏基約 60 小時澆置約 61,000 m³，天津高銀金融 117 以 80 小時澆置 65,000 m³。ACI 301 第 8 節則把巨積混凝土的溫度限值與溫控計畫要求納入規範。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In the 1930s Hoover Dam controlled the hydration heat of mass concrete with block placement and embedded cooling pipes, establishing the engineering methods of thermal control for large volumes. Supertall rafts brought these principles into buildings: in 1999 the Venetian in Las Vegas set a continuous-pour record of about 21,000 cubic yards, and in February 2014 Wilshire Grand Center in Los Angeles broke it with about 21,200 cubic yards (about 16,200 m³) in about 20 hours; Sany reports that Shanghai Tower's raft placed about 61,000 m³ in about 60 hours and that Goldin Finance 117 placed 65,000 m³ in 80 hours. ACI 301 Section 8 brought temperature limits and thermal-control plan requirements for mass concrete into a specification. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
